# AI and LLM Integration

Covers dimension 11 (AI/LLM integration). All citations reference entries
in [citations.md](../citations.md).

---

## AI Architecture

Tines AI runs on AWS Bedrock infrastructure. Data stays in region, is never
logged, and is never used for training [44]. The default LLM is Anthropic
Claude via AWS Bedrock [44].

### Timeline

| Date | Milestone | Source |
|------|-----------|--------|
| 2024 | Initial AI features launched; two-thirds of customers adopted | [4] |
| June 2025 | AI Agent action launched (autonomous agents, copilots) | [45] |
| January 2026 | AI Interaction Layer (unified AI orchestration) | [46] |

## AI Agent Action

The primary AI capability is the AI Agent action [22]:

### Modes

| Mode | Description | Source |
|------|-------------|--------|
| Task | One-shot prompts or autonomous agent with tool use | [22] |
| Chat | Conversational interface hosted on Tines pages | [22] |

In Task mode with tools attached, the model engages in "self-directed
reasoning loops, invoking tools as needed until a solution is reached" [22].

### Tool Categories

| Type | Description | Source |
|------|-------------|--------|
| Templates | Pre-built public or custom integrations | [22] |
| Send to Story | Existing Tines stories as callable functions | [22] |
| Custom Tools | Builder-defined functions within the same story | [22] |
| Internal Tools | Built-in: "Think" (planning), Code Analysis | [22] |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Default | Range | Source |
|-----------|---------|-------|--------|
| Temperature | 0.2 | 0-1 | [22] |
| Timeout | 30 seconds | Configurable | [22] |
| Retry attempts | 25 | Configurable | [22] |
| File types | PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP, PDF, CSV, MD, TXT, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX | — | [22] |
| Files per message | 3 | — | [22] |
| File size limit | 4.5 MB | — | [22] |

### Event Output

Emitted events include [22]:
- Model output (parsed JSON if valid schema)
- Full conversation steps (for tool-using agents)
- Metadata: token counts, credits consumed, model identifier, elapsed
  duration

## MCP Support

Tines supports **both MCP client and MCP server** roles [22][24]:

### MCP Server (Exposing Tines as Tools)

- Tines stories can be exposed as MCP servers [23]
- Compatible clients: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot,
  Windsurf [24]
- Available on **all plans including Community Edition** [24]
- Does **not** consume AI credits [24]
- Self-hosted availability: August 18, 2025 [24]
- Credentials not exposed to MCP clients [24]
- Four access control modes: public, secret, team, tenant [24]
- Unlimited tools per MCP server [24]

### MCP Client (AI Agent Calling External MCP Servers)

- AI Agent action can connect to remote MCP servers [22]
- Supported transports: Streamable HTTP, Plain HTTP (not SSE or stdio) [22]
- Authentication: Bearer tokens, generic headers, OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) [22]
- **Tools only** — Resources, Prompts, and Notifications not supported [22]

## BYOLLM (Bring Your Own LLM)

Users can configure their own LLM providers [30]:
- Supports OpenAI or Anthropic-compatible API endpoints
- Azure OpenAI specifically supported [discovery findings]
- Available on **all tenants including Community Edition** [30]
- When using BYOLLM, **Tines AI credits are not consumed** — costs go to
  the external provider [25][30]
- Custom providers must support streaming and tool use, and be compatible
  with OpenAI chat completions API schema [discovery findings]

## AI Credit System

| Tier | Monthly Credits | Source |
|------|----------------|--------|
| Community | 50 (non-rollover) | [25] |
| Starter | 2,500-10,000 | [25] |
| Business | 10,000 | [5] |
| Enterprise | 100,000 | [5] |

1 credit = $0.01 [25].

What consumes credits [25]:
- AI Agent action (varies by config)
- Workbench messages and tool use

What does **not** consume credits [25]:
- Story Copilot
- MCP server template
- BYOLLM usage

### Rate Limits

| Region | AI Runs/Min | Source |
|--------|------------|--------|
| EU-west-1 | 80 | [25] |
| Other regions | 200 | [25] |
| Custom providers | 1,000 | [25] |

## AI-Assisted Workflow Building

- **Tines Generate**: Natural language → workflow converter [discovery findings]
- **Workbench**: AI chat for querying data and taking action [4][7]
- **Story Copilot**: Conversational workflow building (does not consume
  credits) [25]

---

## Gaps and Limitations

- **No native LLM node like n8n** — requires AI Agent action or HTTP
  requests to LLM APIs [29]
- **MCP client supports tools only** — no resources, prompts, or
  notifications [22]
- **MCP transport limitations** — no SSE or stdio support [22]
- **50 AI credits/mo on Community** — very limited for production use [25]
- **AI Agent not available in personal teams** — prevents credit
  depletion [22]
- **BYOLLM provider requirements** — must be OpenAI chat completions API
  compatible with streaming and tool use [discovery findings]
